story.text: 여기까지 올라오느라 고생했어요. 오늘은 서울에서 제일 좋아하는 자리로 데려오고 싶었어요.
story.reading: yeo-gi-kka-ji ol-la-o-neu-ra go-saeng-hae-sseo-yo. o-neul-eun seo-ul-e-seo je-il jo-a-ha-neun ja-ri-ro de-ryeo-o-go si-peot-seo-yo.
story.en: Thanks for making it all the way up here. Today I wanted to bring you to my favorite spot in all of Seoul.

story.text: 이 '전망대'에서 보면 서울이 다 발아래 있잖아요. 근데 오늘은 승객님밖에 안 보이네요.
story.reading: i jeon-mang-dae-e-seo bo-myeon seo-ul-i da bal-a-rae i-sseo-jan-a-yo. geun-de o-neul-eun seung-gaek-nim-bak-e an bo-i-ne-yo.
story.en: From this 'observation deck', all of Seoul is right beneath us. But today, I only see you.

story.text: 저기 걸린 '자물쇠'들 보이죠? 저도 하나 준비했어요. 승객님이랑 같이 걸고 싶어서.
story.reading: jeo-gi geol-lin ja-mul-soe-deul bo-i-jyo? jeo-do ha-na jun-bi-hae-sseo-yo. seung-gaek-nim-i-rang ga-chi geol-go si-peo-seo.
story.en: See all those 'padlocks' hanging there? I brought one too. I wanted to hang it together with you.

story.text: 능글맞은 농담 뒤에 숨겼던 '고백', 오늘은 제대로 다시 할게요.
story.reading: neung-geul-maj-eun nong-dam dwi-e sum-gyeot-deon go-baek, o-neul-eun je-dae-ro da-si hal-ge-yo.
story.en: The 'confession' I kept hiding behind smooth jokes — today I'll do it properly, for real.

story.text: 이 항로 위에서, 저는 이제 여유를 다 벗어던지고 '진심'만 남기려고요.
story.reading: i hang-no wi-e-seo, jeo-neun i-je yeo-yu-reul da beo-seo-deon-ji-go jin-sim-man nam-gi-ryeo-go-yo.
story.en: Up here on this route, I'm shedding all my usual composure and leaving only 'sincerity' behind.

story.text: 승객님, 저 이거 진짜 '사랑'인 것 같아요. 저랑 이 항로, 앞으로도 계속 같이 갈래요?
story.reading: seung-gaek-nim, jeo i-geo jin-jja sa-rang-in geot gat-a-yo. jeo-rang i hang-no, ap-eu-ro-do gye-sok ga-chi gal-lae-yo?
story.en: You know, I think this is really 'love'. Will you keep flying this route with me from now on?

story.text: ...크흠, 대답은 나중에 들어도 되니까. 일단 오늘 배운 단어들부터 문제로 확인해볼까요?
story.reading: ...keu-heum, dae-dab-eun na-jung-e deul-eo-do doe-ni-kka. il-dan o-neul bae-un dan-eo-deul-bu-teo mun-je-ro hwa-gin-hae-bol-kka-yo?
story.en: ...ahem, you can give me your answer later. For now, shall we check today's words with some questions first?

words.example_en: You can see all of Seoul from the N Seoul Tower observation deck.

sentences.en: You can see all of Seoul from the N Seoul Tower observation deck.
